pages.text: The Charm Pouch holds up to three combat charms. Right-click to open it and slot your charms; while the pouch rides anywhere in your inventory, those charms work passively. The bar on the pouch shows their combined charge.
Charms are not free. An active charm spends its charge each second; stand near a powered altar to refill it — the altar pays for the recharge. A drained charm falls dormant until you charge it again.
